verdict.rationale: The only pricing evidence is marketing copy from coreweave.com/pricing about on-demand and Spot capacity with "great pricing". It quotes no per-GPU-hour rates and does not show that every GPU type is listed publicly without a sales conversation. The billing-insights docs cover a customer's own usage, not public list prices, so they do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see the published per-GPU-hour price for every GPU type on a public pricing page without talking to sales
